cards.name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen

question: If a permanent that isn't a double-faced card, such as Mirror Image, becomes a copy of Nicol Bolas, the Ravager, and I use the ability to exile it and return it transformed, does it come back?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it will only be exiled and won't return to the battlefield at all.
expected.answer: If another permanent that isn't a double-faced card (such as Mirror Image) becomes a copy of Nicol Bolas, the Ravager, activating the ability to exile it and return it transformed will only exile it. It won't return to the battlefield at all.

whyHard: The copy has the ability to return transformed, but only double-faced cards can be returned that way.
